risk_note: DSX-51 admin viewport reflow (规划/05 §3.11.3, D10-724 ②). Tier breakpoints (≥1440 / 1280–1439 / 960–1279 / <960) are defined once in apps/admin/src/layout/viewport.ts (matchMedia ranges) and exposed as html[data-admin-tier]; components/search/search.css and pages/dashboard/dashboard.css (added to paths by #2577) select on the tier instead of writing breakpoint numbers (dashboard 4 / 3 / 2 / 1 columns). A single 收起侧栏 / 展开侧栏 toggle in the top bar collapses or expands the sidebar at every tier (state in layout/sidebar-state.ts, reset to expanded on a new shell); the sidebar stays expanded by default because a frozen admin-risk-rules browser case without a viewport expects the sidebar link; the narrow top bar wraps. No overflow:hidden masking. Non-funds; RV2 only because components/** is shared with the money pages. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in two rounds (round 2: filter wrap compared between 1440 and narrow viewports); Claude spec-test review r1 fail (S1 dashboard.css outside paths, fixed by #2577; S2 filter wrap), r2 pass; red on the local container. Implementation by Opus 5.5; local container verify-fast and browser green on the same tree. Independent Claude money review r1 pass (no findings). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass, no findings (layout only; RV2 because components/** is shared with money pages); independent Claude (approvals #36)
